title: Do not bow to performative holiness
summary: The path is known by honest labor and generosity, not by religious pose. Let conduct answer before performance does.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: The path is known by honest labor and generosity, not by religious pose.
source.lifeApplication: When impressed by spiritual display, look for work, generosity, and humility.

evidence.coreClaim: The path is known by honest labor and generosity, not by religious pose.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: honest labor and sharing reveal the path better than costume.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.
